title: Automated Legacy Report Extraction
business: Financial analysts managing high-volume, non-API legacy desktop applications.
problem: Manual data extraction from proprietary desktop software is slow, error-prone, and prevents real-time reporting.
solution: Deploy a Computer-Use Agent using a local ComputerTool implementation to automate GUI interactions, enabling the agent to navigate legacy interfaces as a human would.
steps: Define a class implementing the AsyncComputer interface to handle mouse and keyboard events.
Initialize an Agent with the custom ComputerTool instance.
Provide system instructions detailing the GUI navigation sequence for the legacy application.
Configure human-in-the-loop approval for high-impact actions like data export.
Execute the agent within a local runtime environment to maintain access to the desktop display.
outcome: Consistent, automated data ingestion from legacy systems into modern analytics pipelines without manual intervention.
limitation: The agent lacks inherent sandbox isolation for local execution; security depends entirely on the permissions granted to the local process.
